name: Zechariah
bio: Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest was moved by the Spirit of God to stand before the people of Judah and rebuke them for abandoning the LORD's commands after his father's death, asking why they could not prosper after forsaking him. King Joash, whom Jehoiada had raised and protected from infancy, had Zechariah stoned to death in the very courtyard of the LORD's temple — repaying Jehoiada's lifelong kindness by murdering his son. As he died, Zechariah said, "May the LORD call you to account" (2 Chronicles 24:20-22). Within the year, the Arameans invaded Judah in judgment, and Joash himself was later assassinated by his own officials in revenge for Zechariah's blood (2 Chronicles 24:23-25).
